Color space to use for the video. Acceptable values: `"default"`(default since 5.0), `"bt601"` (same as `"default"`, since v4.0.424), `"bt709"` (since v4.0.28), `"bt2020-ncl"` (since v4.0.88), `"bt2020-cl"` (since v4.0.88), .<br />For best color accuracy, it is recommended to also use `"png"` as the image format to have accurate color transformations throughout.<br />Only since v4.0.83, colorspace conversion is actually performed, previously it would only tag the metadata of the video.

## CLI flag

```text
--color-space <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#colorspace)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#colorspace)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#colorspace)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#colorspace)
